items.text: CAD and drafting skills lead to careers in mechanical, civil, electrical, architectural and product drawing, where employers expect accurate drawings to standard, clean files, and the ability to follow a markup from an engineer or architect without confusion.
Choose a discipline, learn one drafting tool well, practise drawing to standard and build a drawing set that shows dimensions, notes and revision control.
Check employer requirements and use legitimate student or trial licences.
